title: Key Laboratory of Synthetic and Biological Colloids, Jiangnan University
content:
Aerogel University Research Platform. The Key Laboratory of Synthetic and Biological Colloids at Jiangnan University in Wuxi, China, is a key laboratory of the Ministry of Education founded in 2011. It researches colloid and interface chemistry, synthetic colloids, soft matter, and biocolloids.

Research groups at the laboratory have carried out systematic work on aerogel functional composites, including polyimide nanofibrous aerogels for thermal insulation and ceramifiable polymer aerogels for thermal protection. Its strengths in colloidal assembly and polymer chemistry make it relevant for aerogel materials design, composite construction, and related characterization work.
